title: Musical Madness
theme: Disney songs and songwriters: the Sherman Brothers, Alan Menken, Lin-Manuel Miranda and more
intro: [excited] Warm up those vocal cords, because tonight is MUSICAL MADNESS! The Sherman Brothers, Alan Menken, Lin-Manuel Miranda... [laughs] and me, singing badly between rounds. You've been warned.

art.prompt: A grand concert stage at night with a glowing grand piano, sheet music swirling into the air like birds, a golden spotlight, a conductor's baton on a music stand and musical-note shaped sparkles over a velvet red curtain, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Practically Perfect Pitch
categories.intro: [chuckles] Spit spot! This category is all about Mary Poppins, the Sherman Brothers' masterpiece. Supercalifragilistic answers only.

art.prompt: A rooftop view of foggy Edwardian London at dusk with chimneys, a flying kite, a red umbrella floating on the wind, a carpetbag and chalk drawings on the pavement below, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mary Poppins floats down from the sky over London holding onto this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an umbrella! [laughs] And hers has a talking parrot head handle. Mine just flips inside out.

clues.clue: Mary, Bert and the children jump right into one of these, drawn on the pavement, for a jolly holiday.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a chalk drawing! [excited] Bert's sidewalk art had dancing penguins. Mine has a lopsided sun.

clues.clue: This song about the Bird Woman on the steps of St. Paul's Cathedral was reportedly Walt Disney's favorite.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Feed the Birds! [sighs] Walt would ask Richard Sherman to play it for him on Friday afternoons. Tuppence well spent.

clues.clue: Jane and Michael's stern banker father, who learns to fly a kite by the end of the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is George Banks! [chuckles] He went from bank work to kite work. Honestly, a promotion.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins was adapted from the books of this author, who famously clashed with Walt over the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is P. L. Travers! [sarcastic] She hated the animated penguins. Who hates PENGUINS?

categories.title: Composer's Corner
categories.intro: [excited] The geniuses behind the music! Let's see if you know your Menken from your Miranda.

art.prompt: A cozy composer's studio with an upright piano covered in handwritten sheet music, coffee cups, crumpled paper, a desk lamp, a golden award statuette silhouette shape and a window looking out at a starry city, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote We Don't Talk About Bruno for this 2021 movie about a magical family.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Encanto! [laughs] We don't talk about Bruno... except all the time, constantly, at every party.

clues.clue: This composer wrote and sang You've Got a Friend in Me for Toy Story.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Randy Newman! [chuckles] That gravelly voice is basically a warm hug in song form.

clues.clue: Phil Collins wrote and performed You'll Be in My Heart for this 1999 jungle movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tarzan! [excited] And it won the Oscar. Phil even re-recorded the songs in several languages.

clues.clue: Alan Menken's original lyricist partner on The Little Mermaid and Beauty and the Beast, who died in 1991.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Howard Ashman! [sighs] Beauty and the Beast is dedicated to him. To our friend Howard, who gave a mermaid her voice.

clues.clue: Alan Menken has won this many Academy Awards, four for Best Song and four for Best Score.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is EIGHT! More Oscars than any other living person. He needs a bigger shelf.

categories.title: Sherman Showcase
categories.intro: [laughs] Two brothers, one piano, and about a billion earworms. It's the Sherman Brothers showcase!

art.prompt: Two vintage upright pianos facing each other in a sunny 1960s songwriting office, sheet music, a bowl of honey, a kite on the wall and a small purple paper dragon on a shelf, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Shermans wrote a bouncy song about this Hundred Acre Wood character, who's the only one.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tigger! [excited] Bouncy, trouncy, flouncy, pouncy... fun, fun, fun, fun, FUN!

clues.clue: The Sherman Brothers wrote I Wan'na Be Like You for this swinging jungle king.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King Louie! [chuckles] He just wanted the secret of man's red fire. Relatable, honestly.

clues.clue: Outside of Disney, the Shermans wrote the songs for this 1968 movie about a flying car.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chitty Chitty Bang Bang! [laughs] A car that flies AND floats. My car makes a weird noise when I turn left.

clues.clue: The Shermans wrote One Little Spark for this purple dragon at EPCOT.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Figment! [excited] One little spark of inspiration... and one purple dragon who lives rent free in our heads.

clues.clue: In 2008 the Sherman Brothers received this, the highest award given to artists by the United States government.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the National Medal of Arts! [whispers] Presented at the White House. Not bad for a couple of guys who rhymed tuppence.

categories.title: Picture the Song
categories.intro: [excited] I'm showing you a scene inspired by a famous Disney song. You name that tune! Bonus points if you sing it. [laughs] Please don't sing it.

art.prompt: A giant open storybook whose pages burst into musical scenes: a coral reef, floating lanterns, swirling leaves and dancing teacups, all connected by a ribbon of golden music notes, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Name the Disney song this scene illustrates.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Under the Sea! [laughs] Darling, it's better, down where it's wetter. Take it from me.

media.prompt: A bright coral reef concert with seashell drums, a conch-shell horn, a kelp harp, a clam-shell xylophone and streams of bubbles in turquoise water, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Name the Disney song this enchanted dinner scene illustrates.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Be Our Guest! [chuckles] Try the grey stuff. It's delicious. Don't believe me? Ask the dishes.

media.prompt: An elegant candlelit castle dining hall where plates, napkins, teacups and silverware dance in the air above a long table, champagne fountain and fireworks of light, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Name the Disney song this floating-lantern scene illustrates.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is I See the Light! [sighs] Thousands of floating lanterns. Romance level: MAXIMUM.

media.prompt: Thousands of glowing paper lanterns rising over a calm lake at night near a hilltop kingdom, with a small wooden rowboat drifting on the water, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Name the Disney song this swirling autumn scene illustrates.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colors of the Wind! It won the Oscar for Alan Menken and Stephen Schwartz. [whispers] Can you paint with all the colors?

media.prompt: A rainbow of swirling autumn leaves carried by the wind over a waterfall cliff and a forest river in early America, a silver moon and a howling wolf silhouette on a ridge, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Name the Disney song this surreal dream scene illustrates.
choices: When I See an Elephant Fly
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Pink Elephants on Parade! From Dumbo, 1941. Still the trippiest four minutes in Disney history.

media.prompt: A surreal pitch-black dreamscape with translucent glowing pink elephants made of soap bubbles marching in a line, playing trumpets and drums, swirling psychedelic colors, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

categories.title: Songs in the Parks
categories.intro: [chuckles] The parks are basically one giant playlist. Let's see which tunes are stuck in YOUR head.

art.prompt: A sunny turn-of-the-century theme park main street bandstand with a straw boater hat, a striped vest on a chair, a banjo, a twinkling night parade float made of colorful lights in the distance, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom's Country Bear Musical Jamboree, the singing animatronic performers are these animals.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is bears! [laughs] Big Al has been off key since 1971 and we LOVE him for it.

clues.clue: On Main Street, U.S.A., this barbershop quartet in striped vests and straw hats sings old-fashioned harmonies.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Dapper Dans! [excited] They sing, they tap, and they ride a four-person bicycle. Showoffs.

clues.clue: In this Fantasyland 3D show, Donald Duck borrows Mickey's sorcerer hat and gets swept through famous Disney songs.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey's PhilharMagic! [laughs] Donald should NEVER be trusted with a magic hat.

clues.clue: The bouncy synthesizer tune Baroque Hoedown is the theme of this nighttime parade that first rolled at Disneyland in 1972.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Main Street Electrical Parade! [whispers] Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls...

clues.clue: Film composer Jerry Goldsmith, famous for Star Trek, wrote the soaring score for this hang-gliding attraction, which first flew in 2001.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Soarin'! [sighs] He reportedly cried after his first ride. Me too, but that was the orange smell.
